name: Harrison Gray
source:
He is an aloof and popular man who belongs to the Crown, the royal command unit under the direct control of the Queen.

He often tells frivolous lies, making it difficult to know where his true intentions lie.

He seems to have a "certain reason" for joining the Crown...

Organisation: Crown
Fairy Tale Curse: ???

[Translated from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/villains/original/character/#harrison]official website[/url]]
